ElmsLookingForYouText:
Oh, {PLAYER}…! Our
neighbor, PROF.

ELM, was looking
for you.

He said he wanted
you to do some- thing for him.

Oh! I almost for-
got! Your #MON

GEAR is back from
the repair shop.

Here you go!
MomGivesPokegearText:
#MON GEAR, or
just #GEAR.

It's essential if
you want to be a good trainer.

Oh, the day of the
week isn't set.

You mustn't forget
that!
IsItDSTText:
Is it Daylight
Saving Time now?
ComeHomeForDSTText:
Come home to
adjust your clock

for Daylight
Saving Time.

By the way, do you
know how to use the PHONE?
KnowTheInstructionsText:
Don't you just
turn the #GEAR

on and select the
PHONE icon?
DontKnowTheInstructionsText:
I'll read the
instructions.

Turn the #GEAR
on and select the PHONE icon.
InstructionsNextText:
Phone numbers are
stored in memory.

Just choose a name
you want to call.

Gee, isn't that
convenient?
HurryUpElmIsWaitingText:
PROF.ELM is wait-
ing for you.

Hurry up, baby!
SoWhatWasProfElmsErrandText:
So, what was PROF.
ELM's errand?

…

That does sound
challenging.

But, you should be
proud that people rely on you.
ImBehindYouText:
{PLAYER}, do it!

I'm behind you all
the way!
NeighborText:
, have you
heard?

My daughter is
adamant about

becoming PROF.
ELM's assistant.

She really loves
#MON!
PlayersHouse1FSinkText:
The sink is spot-
less. Mom likes it clean.
PlayersHouse1FFridgeText:
Let's see what's
in the fridge…

FRESH WATER and
tasty LEMONADE!
PlayersHouse1FTVText:
There's a movie on
TV: Stars dot the

sky as two boys
ride on a train…

I'd better get
rolling too!
